milestones.name: Internal Alpha
notes: Alpha synthetic 15–25 tasks, real greenfield useful desktop app 15–25 tasks, existing separate copy Cudy or comparable 5–10 tasks (not preauthorized); optional dogfood 3–5 tasks. Evaluation mandatory, practical dogfood optional. No production projects modified without authorization.

Proposed stress matrix: 24/72h synthetic, 5 projects, 10k tasks, 100 simulated agents, 2–4 real concurrent runs subject to quota/approval, 1000 simulated runs, 20 core restarts/worker crashes, 100 project switches, 100k logs, 1000 simulated syncs. 50% active human coordination reduction hypothesis, not release gate. S0 critical/S1 high both block; S2 case-by-case, S3 low, S4 enhancement.

Produce sanitized ALPHA_TEST_REPORT.md, SECURITY_VALIDATION.md, PERFORMANCE_BENCHMARK.md, WORKFLOW_COMPARISON.md, CASE_STUDY.md, KNOWN_ISSUES.md, ALPHA_ACCEPTANCE.md. External tester optional; no invented feedback.
